headline_marked: Criminals [[shoot and hack man to death]] in Khulna
headline: Criminals shoot and hack man to death in Khulna
summary: Md Ismail, 32, was targeted in the South Tutpara Boro Khalpar area early Friday morning.
details: A 32-year-old man, identified as Md Ismail (locally known as 'Pagla Shahjahan'), was killed by criminals in Khulna city early Friday.
The attack occurred around 12:15 am in the South Tutpara Boro Khalpar area, where assailants opened fire on Ismail.
Ismail was rushed to Khulna Medical College Hospital with a bullet wound to the head, where doctors declared him dead.
Police suspect the attackers first shot him in the head and subsequently attacked him with a sharp weapon.
According to police, Ismail was known as a drug trader and armed criminal with several cases filed against him, including murder and police assault.
Officers from the Khulna Sadar Police Station have visited the scene and collected evidence for their investigation.
The body has been kept at the Khulna Medical College morgue for an autopsy while police work to identify and arrest the perpetrators.
caption:
A man known as a local criminal was shot in the head and hacked to death in Khulna.

A 32-year-old man, identified as Md Ismail (locally known as 'Pagla Shahjahan'), was killed by criminals in Khulna city early Friday.

The attack occurred around 12:15 am in the South Tutpara Boro Khalpar area, where assailants opened fire on Ismail.

Ismail was rushed to Khulna Medical College Hospital with a bullet wound to the head, where doctors declared him dead.

Police suspect the attackers first shot him in the head and subsequently attacked him with a sharp weapon.

According to police, Ismail was known as a drug trader and armed criminal with several cases filed against him, including murder and police assault.

Officers from the Khulna Sadar Police Station have visited the scene and collected evidence for their investigation.

The body has been kept at the Khulna Medical College morgue for an autopsy while police work to identify and arrest the perpetrators.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
